previous_statement: Multiplication. The exact source identity (XY)_jl=sum_{k=1}^2 X_jk Y_kl, bilinearity, and the compressed-product compatibility clause compare gamma_n(XY) with the sum of the eight compatible compressed products with total error at most a universal multiple of rho||X||||Y||. By def-compressed-corner each compatible compressed product differs from the ambient product by O(e); every incompatible ambient corner product is O(e) by the same left-right-compression and approximate-orthogonality calculation as in node 1.1.2. Expanding gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y) into its sixteen terms therefore gives ||gamma_n(XY)-gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y)||<=K_mult e||X||||Y||, with K_mult universal and independent of n.
new_statement: Multiplication, in the universal small-e regime in which the compressed-corner estimates apply. For U_jk in M_n tensor S_{P_j,P_k} and V_lm in M_n tensor S_{P_l,P_m}, the refinements below derive uniformly in n that ||U_jk V_lm||<=K_inc e||U_jk||||V_lm|| when k!=l, directly from approximate support, target complementarity, the epsilon-associator, and the product-norm axiom. The exact source block-product identity, compressed-product compatibility, and expansion into eight compatible and eight incompatible terms then give ||gamma_n(XY)-gamma_n(X)gamma_n(Y)||<=K_mult e||X||||Y|| for a universal K_mult.
